title: 第二十五章 幕后黑手露端倪第二十六章 离家远行避灾劫
content_zh:
污浊的臭水沟在脚下翻涌着气泡，腐烂的食物残渣和不明污物散发出令人作呕的酸臭，几乎要凝滞呼吸。楚夜将自己深深嵌入两座歪斜棚屋之间最狭窄的缝隙里，后背紧贴着冰冷潮湿、布满黏滑苔藓的墙壁。伤口在每一次急促的呼吸中都传来撕裂般的剧痛，双臂那深可见骨的创口边缘，诡异的灰败色正在缓慢却顽固地向着健康的皮肉蔓延，带来冰冷刺骨的麻木和细微的、如同无数小虫啃噬般的痒痛。
“蚀骨灰烬”…这名字倒是贴切。楚夜咬紧牙关，混沌灵力艰难地运转，试图驱散这股阴毒的侵蚀之力，但收效甚微。这灰色毒素与他道骨上那团印记同源，却更加霸道，仿佛活物，不断抵消、吞噬着他的混沌能量。
棚户区深处并不平静。远处隐约传来呵斥声、翻箱倒柜的声响，甚至还有零星的、被强行压下去的哭喊和哀求。追兵已经开始进行拉网式的搜查了，而且手段粗暴，毫不顾忌这里的居民。
楚夜闭上眼睛，将心神沉入体内。他小心翼翼地分出一缕微弱的精神力，如同触摸烧红的烙铁般，触碰着道骨深处那团躁动不安的灰色印记。
嗡…
印记传来一阵冰冷的、带着贪婪和暴戾情绪的波动。通过这缕精神连接，一种极其模糊、却异常清晰的方位感，如同无形的丝线，遥遥指向西北方向——那是黑岩城城主府的核心区域！而更具体的位置…似乎还在缓慢移动？
果然！那滴蕴含着他鲜血和灰色气息的血珠，如同最隐秘的标记，已经成功附着在了那名黑衣人身上！这灰色气息之间，竟能产生如此诡异的感应！
就在这时——
嚓…嚓…
极其轻微，却异常规律的脚步声，在距离楚夜藏身之处不足十丈外的一条污水横流的小巷中响起。脚步落地极稳，带着一种经过严格训练的、近乎机械的精准，与贫民区居民虚浮、杂乱的脚步截然不同。
楚夜瞬间屏住呼吸，将自身生机收敛到极致，混沌道骨微微震颤，散发出微弱的波动，将他残存的气息彻底扰乱、隔绝。
两名身穿普通粗布衣服、却依旧难掩那股精悍冰冷气息的汉子，出现在巷口。他们伪装成了贫民，但那双锐利如鹰、不断扫视四周的眼睛，以及腰间那不自然的鼓起，彻底暴露了他们的身份。是黑衣人的同伙！他们改变了装束，融入了环境，进行更隐蔽的搜查！
其中一人手中拿着一个巴掌大小、类似罗盘的金属仪器，仪器屏幕一片灰白，不断闪烁着“信号干扰”的符文字样。他烦躁地拍了拍仪器：“妈的，这破地方的法则压制太诡异了，刚才那天威过后，‘灵犀盘’还是没法用！只能靠肉眼和感应慢慢搜！”
另一人声音低沉：“耐心点。‘庚七’和‘庚八’失手了，目标比预想的更难缠。‘影先生’已经动怒，我们必须在他彻底失去耐心前，找到那小子！他中了‘灰烬’，跑不远！”
“灰烬之毒无人能解，除非…哼，他此刻定然痛苦万分，如同瓮中之鳖！”
两人低声交谈着，目光如同探照灯般扫过每一个可能藏人的角落，缓缓从楚夜藏身的缝隙前经过。他们并未发现近在咫尺的楚夜，但那冰冷的杀意和毫不掩饰的搜寻姿态，让楚夜的心沉了下去。
“影先生”…“庚”字编号…“灵犀盘”…“法则压制”…“灰烬之毒”…
一个个陌生的词语，却透露出惊人的信息！这个组织等级森严，拥有着不同于寻常修士的诡异装备和技术，甚至…他们似乎对天道意志的压制有所了解？他们来自“囚笼”之外？
就在楚夜心思急转之时，那两名伪装者似乎接到了什么指令。其中一人按了按耳朵里一个微小的黑色晶体，低声道：“…是！明白！优先确保‘钥匙’载体存活，若事不可为，清除所有污染痕迹，回收核心碎片…”
钥匙载体？是在指自己？核心碎片…是那块石壁？

两人得到新指令，迅速转身，朝着另一个方向快步离去，显然有了更明确的目标。
不能再等了！必须主动出击！趁着对方分散搜寻，抓住一个“舌头”，撬开他的嘴！
楚夜眼中寒光一闪。他强忍着剧痛和虚弱，如同壁虎般悄无声息地从缝隙中滑出，落地无声。他选中了那个落在稍后位置、手中拿着失灵“灵犀盘”的追踪者。
脚步轻点污秽的地面，身影如同鬼魅般融入阴影，悄然尾随而上。
前方的两名追踪者十分警惕，即便在交谈中也保持着良好的战术队形，相互照应。但楚夜耐心十足，如同最有经验的猎手，利用棚户区复杂的地形和随处可见的废弃物作为掩护，一点点拉近着距离。
机会出现在一条堆满了破旧箩筐和废弃家具的狭窄过道。那名拿着灵犀盘的追踪者似乎被脚下一個突然窜出的老鼠惊扰，下意识地低头避让，脚步慢了半拍。
就是现在！
楚夜体内所剩不多的混沌灵力轰然爆发！他不再掩饰行踪，身体如同扑食的猎豹，从一堆箩筐后暴射而出！速度快到极致，目标直指那名落后的追踪者！
“敌袭！”另一名追踪者反应极快，厉喝出声，反手就抽向腰间的武器！
但楚夜的速度更快！他根本不管另一人的反应，全部的精神和力量都锁定了目标！灌注着混沌灵力的左手五指成爪，带着撕裂空气的尖啸，直抓向那名追踪者持着灵犀盘的右手手腕！意图夺下那件可能拥有通讯功能的仪器，并制住对方！
那追踪者也是身经百战，虽惊不乱，左手并指如刀，带着一股凌厉的劲风，狠狠切向楚夜的手腕要害，同时身体向后急退，试图拉开距离！
砰！
手刀与手爪碰撞，发出沉闷的声响！混沌灵力与对方某种奇特的、带着金属锐气的能量狠狠撞在一起！
楚夜身形微微一滞，手臂伤口传来钻心的剧痛。而那追踪者则脸色一白，显然在纯粹的力量对碰上吃了亏，闷哼一声，后退的步伐更加踉跄。
“找死！”另一名追踪者的攻击已然到达！一把闪烁着幽蓝电弧的短刃如同毒蛇般刺向楚夜的肋下！
楚夜仿佛背后长眼，看也不看，右脚如同铁鞭般向后猛地踹出，精准地踢在对方的手腕上！同时，他的右手快如闪电般探出，不再是抓向手腕，而是变爪为指，指尖混沌毫光凝聚如针，带着一股破灭的气息，瞬间点向那名落后追踪者的眉心！
围魏救赵！攻其必救！
那追踪者感受到眉心传来的致命威胁，瞳孔骤缩，所有防御本能地集中向头部！
content_en:
The filthy and smelly ditch was bubbling with bubbles underfoot, and the rotten food residue and unknown filth emitted a disgusting sour smell that almost made one's breath stagnant. Chu Ye embedded himself deeply into the narrowest gap between the two slanted shacks, his back pressed against the cold, damp wall covered with slimy moss. The wound felt like tearing pain with every rapid breath. On the edges of the bone-deep wound on both arms, a strange gray color was slowly but stubbornly spreading towards the healthy skin, bringing a cold and biting numbness and a subtle itching pain like countless bugs.
"Bone-eating Ashes"...this name is quite appropriate. Chu Ye gritted his teeth and struggled with his chaotic spiritual power, trying to dispel this sinister corrosive power, but with little success. This gray poison has the same origin as the mark on his Taoist bones, but it is more domineering, like a living creature, constantly counteracting and devouring his chaotic energy.
There is no peace deep in the shanty towns. There were faint sounds of scolding, rummaging through boxes, and even sporadic, forcibly suppressed cries and pleas in the distance. The pursuers have already begun to conduct a dragnet-style search, and their methods are rough and have no regard for the residents here.
Chu Ye closed his eyes and let his mind sink into his body. He carefully separated out a weak ray of spiritual power, touching the restless gray mark deep in his bones like a red-hot iron.
Buzz…
There was a cold wave of greed and violent emotions coming from the mark. Through this spiritual connection, an extremely vague but extremely clear sense of direction, like an invisible thread, points far to the northwest - that is the core area of ​​the Black Rock City Lord's Mansion! And the more specific location... seems to be moving slowly?
really! The drop of blood containing his blood and gray aura, like the most secret mark, has successfully attached to the man in black! This gray aura can produce such a strange feeling!
Just then——
Cha…cha…
Extremely slight but unusually regular footsteps sounded in an alleyway with sewage flowing less than ten feet away from Chu Ye's hiding place. The steps landed extremely steadily, with a rigorously trained, almost mechanical precision, which was completely different from the superficial and chaotic steps of the slum dwellers.
Chu Ye held his breath for a moment, condensing his vitality to the extreme. The chaotic bones trembled slightly, emitting weak fluctuations, completely disrupting and isolating his remaining breath.
Two men wearing ordinary coarse cloth, but still unable to conceal their strong and cold aura, appeared at the entrance of the alley. They disguised themselves as poor people, but their sharp eagle-like eyes that constantly scanned the surroundings and the unnatural bulge at their waists completely exposed their identities. An accomplice of the man in black! They change their outfits, blend into the environment, and conduct more covert searches!
One of them held a palm-sized metal instrument similar to a compass in his hand. The screen of the instrument was gray and white, and the words "signal interference" were flashing continuously. He patted the instrument irritably: "Damn it, the law suppression in this broken place is too weird. After the power of that day passed just now, the 'Spirit Disk' still cannot be used! We can only search slowly with the naked eye and induction!"
The other person's voice was low: "Be patient. 'Gengqi' and 'Gengba' have missed, and the target is more difficult than expected. 'Mr. Shadow' is already angry. We must find that kid before he completely loses patience! He has been hit by 'Ashes' and can't run far!"
"No one can cure the poison of ash, unless... hmph, he must be in great pain at this moment, like a turtle in a urn!"
The two chatted in low voices, their eyes scanning every corner where someone might be hiding like a searchlight, and slowly passed by the gap where Chu Ye was hiding. They didn't notice Chu Ye so close at hand, but the cold murderous intent and unabashed searching gesture made Chu Ye's heart sink.
"Mr. Shadow"..."G" number..."Lingxi Disk"..."Law Suppression"..."Grey""The Poison of Ember"...
Each unfamiliar word reveals surprising information! This organization is highly hierarchical and possesses weird equipment and techniques that are different from ordinary monks. They even seem to have some understanding of the suppression of the will of heaven? Are they from outside the "cage"?
Just when Chu Ye's thoughts were changing, the two pretenders seemed to have received some instructions. One of them pressed a tiny black crystal in his ear and whispered: "...Yes! clear! Prioritize the survival of the 'key' carrier. If nothing can be done, remove all traces of contamination and recover the core fragments..."
Key carrier? Are you referring to yourself? The core fragment...is that stone wall?
After receiving the new instructions, the two quickly turned around and hurried away in another direction, obviously with a clearer goal.
Can't wait any longer! You must take the initiative! While the other person is distracted and searching, grab a "tongue" and pry open his mouth!
Chu Ye's eyes flashed coldly. He endured the severe pain and weakness, slipped out of the gap as quietly as a gecko, and landed silently. He selected the tracker who was behind him and was holding a malfunctioning "telephone disk".
The footsteps lightly touched the dirty ground, and the figure blended into the shadows like a ghost, quietly following behind.
The two trackers in front were very alert, maintaining a good tactical formation and looking out for each other even during the conversation. But Chu Ye was very patient, like the most experienced hunter, using the complex terrain of the shanty town and the ubiquitous waste as cover to close the distance little by little.
The opportunity presented itself in a narrow aisle filled with old baskets and discarded furniture. The tracker holding the telepathy disk seemed to be disturbed by a mouse that suddenly jumped out from under his feet. He subconsciously lowered his head to avoid it and slowed down his steps for half a beat.
That's it now!
The few chaotic spiritual powers left in Chu Ye's body exploded! He no longer concealed his whereabouts, his body shot out from behind a pile of baskets like a cheetah pouncing on prey! The speed is extremely fast, and the target is pointed at the pursuer who is lagging behind!
"Enemy attack! "The other tracker reacted very quickly, shouted loudly, and drew the weapon at his waist with his backhand!
But Chu Ye is faster! He didn't care about the other person's reaction at all, all his energy and strength were locked on the target! The five fingers of his left hand filled with chaotic spiritual power formed into claws, and with a scream that ripped through the air, it grabbed directly at the tracker's right wrist holding the telepathy disk! The intention is to seize the instrument that may have communication capabilities and restrain the other party!
The pursuer was also experienced in many battles. Although he was frightened, he pointed his left hand like a knife, and with a strong wind, he slashed towards the vital part of Chu Ye's wrist. At the same time, his body retreated sharply, trying to distance himself!
Bang!
The hand knife collided with the hand claw, making a dull sound! The chaotic spiritual power collided with the opponent's strange, metallic energy!
Chu Ye's figure froze slightly, and a heartbreaking pain came from the wound on his arm. The pursuer's face paled, obviously suffering from the sheer force of the confrontation. He grunted and staggered back even more.
"Seeking death! "Another pursuer's attack has arrived! A short blade flashing with a blue arc of electricity stabbed into Chu Ye's ribs like a poisonous snake!
Chu Ye seemed to have eyes behind his back, and without even looking, he kicked his right foot backwards like an iron whip, accurately hitting the opponent's wrist! At the same time, his right hand reached out as fast as lightning. It no longer grabbed the wrist, but turned into a claw. The chaotic light on the fingertips condensed like a needle, and with an aura of destruction, it instantly pointed at the brow of the lagging pursuer!
Surround Wei and rescue Zhao! Attack it and you will save it!
The pursuer felt the fatal threat coming from between his eyebrows, his pupils shrank suddenly, and all his defenses instinctively focused on his head!
